# Monterey Golf Tours

> Custom Monterey Peninsula golf trips planned end to end — tee times, lodging, and logistics for groups of 2–300 players across the peninsula's public, resort, and Pebble Beach Resorts® courses.

Monterey Golf Tours (montereygolftours.com) is a golf trip planning service founded by Sean Schaeffer. We specialize in multi-day golf packages on the Monterey Peninsula — Monterey, Carmel, Carmel Valley, Pacific Grove, Seaside, and the Pebble Beach area. We do not sell individual tee times; we plan complete trips. As an IAGTO-contracted travel partner with Pebble Beach Resorts®, we can book Pebble Beach Golf Links®, Spyglass Hill® Golf Course, Del Monte™ Golf Course, and The Hay™. The Links at Spanish Bay® is closed for renovation until April 17, 2027.

Contact: info@montereygolftours.com | (866) 278-7010 | https://montereygolftours.com/quote/

## Golf Courses

- [Pebble Beach Golf Links®](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/pebble-beach-golf-links/): Par 72, 6,802 yards. Jack Neville and Douglas Grant (1919). IAGTO rates available.
- [Spyglass Hill® Golf Course](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/spyglass-hill/): Par 72, 6,960 yards, rating 75.4, slope 145. Robert Trent Jones Sr. Toughest of the Pebble Beach Resorts® courses.
- [Del Monte™ Golf Course](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/del-monte-golf-course/): Par 72, 6,356 yards. Opened 1897 — oldest golf course in continuous use west of the Mississippi.
- [The Hay™](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/the-hay/): Par 27, 670 yards, 9-hole short course. Tiger Woods and TGR Design redesign (2021).
- [The Links at Spanish Bay®](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/links-at-spanish-bay/): CLOSED — Gil Hanse renovation. Reopens April 17, 2027. Waitlist available.
- [Bayonet](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/bayonet/): Par 72, 7,024 yards, slope 139. Former Fort Ord. Golf Digest Top 35 toughest public courses.
- [Black Horse](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/black-horse/): Par 72, 7,024 yards, slope 141. Bayonet's sister course, Monterey Bay views.
- [Poppy Hills Golf Course](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/poppy-hills/): Par 71, 7,091 yards. NCGA-owned in Del Monte Forest. No Pebble Beach gate fee.
- [Pacific Grove Golf Links](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/pacific-grove-golf-links/): Par 70, 5,727 yards. Municipal, coastal, accessible pricing.
- [Laguna Seca Golf Ranch](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/laguna-seca-golf-ranch/): Par 71, 6,226 yards. Daily-fee, close to downtown Monterey.
- [Carmel Valley Ranch Golf](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/carmel-valley-ranch/): Par 70. Pete Dye — his only Northern California design.
- [Quail Lodge & Golf Club](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/quail-lodge/): Par 71, 6,500 yards. Robert Muir Graves (1964).
- [Pasatiempo Golf Course](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/pasatiempo/): Par 70, 6,473 yards, slope 143. Alister MacKenzie (1929) — his home course. Santa Cruz.
- [TPC Monterey at Pasadera](https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/club-at-pasadera/): Jack Nicklaus Signature. Monday public access only.

## Hotels & Lodging

- [The Lodge at Pebble Beach™](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/lodge-at-pebble-beach/): Open since 1919. Frames 18th green of Pebble Beach Golf Links®. Fairway One Cottages on first fairway.
- [The Inn at Spanish Bay™](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/inn-at-spanish-bay/): 270 rooms. Gas fireplace in every room. Bagpiper plays at sunset.
- [Casa Palmero®](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/casa-palmero/): 24-room boutique estate within Pebble Beach Resorts®.
- [Hyatt Regency Monterey](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/hyatt-regency-monterey/): Sits directly on Del Monte™ Golf Course. 560 rooms.
- [Carmel Valley Ranch](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/carmel-valley-ranch/): All-suite resort with on-site Pete Dye course. Fog-free.
- [Quail Lodge & Golf Club](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/quail-lodge/): On-site golf. Carmel Valley.
- [Portola Hotel & Spa](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/portola-hotel/): Downtown Monterey. Connected to conference center.
- [Monterey Plaza Hotel & Spa](https://montereygolftours.com/hotels/monterey-plaza-hotel/): Forbes Four-Star. Cannery Row, on the bay.
